_comment: Exact environment of every documented benchmark run. See results/README.md for the artifact layout and README 'How Compact competes' for the tables these numbers back.

compactq.documented_runs: 0.1.x engine (identical optimization-pass code; the 0.1.1 release adds objective selection without changing the default '2q' pipeline)
compactq.pre_release_provenance: iterations v0.6-v2.6 during the 2026-09-10..16 prototyping sprint; the bench_results.md artifact generated on 2026-09-16 recorded the then-local version 2.4.0 at commit 760206fa64e2 - same engine, retired versioning
compactq.release_verification: gauntlet 1018/1018 re-verified on the 0.1.0 release commit, 2026-09-17

competitors.bqskit: not yet benchmarked (roadmap: benchmark suite v1)

protocol.inputs: identical input circuit per tool (QASMBench unitary cores, level-0 normalized, same basis; MQT Bench flattened to one register)
protocol.metrics: total gates / 2-qubit gates / depth / wall time
protocol.timings: wall-clock, single run unless stated best-of-3
protocol.referee: qiskit.quantum_info.Operator fidelity |Tr(U+V)|/d, never compactq's own math
